title: Accepted-first fixture dependency prevents audit qualification
symptom: An approved same-PR fixture follow-up does not count as native coverage because its declared dependency requires the parent to be accepted first.
trigger: Run native fixture check or the verify lane while the approved identity parent is verifying.
expected: Qualify the parent and its approved fixture together before human acceptance, using an ordering plan supported by native tooling.
actual: The fixture check refuses until parent acceptance and native audit reports tests/next.rs uncovered; all 182 product tests pass on both toolchains.
impact: Blocks full verify, native closeout and merge qualification despite passing product tests.

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: The obsolete observation-ID fixture defect is fixed and has a later passing case. This is a separate planning/recovery gap in the accepted-first native dependency.
